description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [Physical High Quick Cast 3], [Last Stand] and [Haste], grants [Awoken Support] to the user

description.name: Awoken Support
description.text: White Magic and Monk abilities don't consume uses, White Magic and Monk abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [10% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]/[15% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]/[20% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]/[30% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]/[40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using White Magic or Monk abilities at rank 1/2/3/4/5

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: KO
description.text: Automatically set when HP reaches 0, prevents from acting, counts towards Game Over, persists after battle
